headline: 10 of 10 in 35:08 with no boss deaths, every boss under its median

mvp.headline: average parse 94, never under 86
why: 98 on Magmadar and Golemagg, 96 on Garr and Geddon, the highest average in the raid
Landed a Tranquilizing Shot on Magmadar and didn't die all night

also.text: 81 dispels, 5 Impending Dooms on Lucifron and 6 Ignite Manas on Geddon
18 curses removed on Lucifron and Gehennas

overview: A clean MC an hour after BWL: 35:08 against the guild's usual 45:03, no wipes, and no deaths on any boss. Raid DPS was over the guild's usual on all ten, from Majordomo (17k against 12k) to Ragnaros (22k against 16k).
The weak spot was curses: half of Gehennas' Curses (17 of 34) and almost all of Shazzrah's (29 of 35) were never removed, and Lucifron's took a median 7.8 seconds to come off.

Skooma came to MC on a warrior and averaged 64, with 40 on Magmadar and 50 on Sulfuron, an hour after the same player parsed 96 in BWL on the druid. Different character, same habit of being nowhere near the top of the meter.

wentWell.text: Ragnaros in 0:50 against a median of 1:08, no deaths, Lava Burst hitting under the usual rate.
Majordomo in 0:51 against a median of 1:10, nobody died.
Baron Geddon in 0:35 (median 0:46). No deaths, with Labwar carrying the one Living Bomb.
